disclaimer: The AI only receives the evidence the system gathered (SQL, plan, computed risks), never your data rows. Its answer may be wrong and is not a conclusion of the system.
questionPlaceholder: For example: why does this query read so many pages?
tooLong: The question is {count} characters long, the limit is {max}. Shorten it before sending.
empty: No question yet. Type one and press Send. SQL suggested by the AI only appears after it has been trial-run in your browser.
aiTag: AI words, not a conclusion of the system
incomplete: Not finished: this is only the part received before it stopped or failed. The SQL blocks in it were not trial-run, so they are not shown.
rebuildFailed: The PostgreSQL session could not be rebuilt after stopping. Reload the page before running anything else.
emptyAnswer: The AI returned an empty answer. Try asking again.
sqlPending: A SQL block is waiting to be checked. Its content only appears if the trial run passes.
sqlUnchecked: A SQL block was not checked, so it is not shown.
verifyFailed: This SQL block could not be trial-run, so it is not shown.
hiddenCount: {count, plural, one {# SQL block not shown} other {# SQL blocks not shown}}
ranHere: Trial-run in your browser, no data changed.
pages: Pages read in the trial run: {pages}
pagesChange: Pages read by the measured query: {before} before, {after} after, in this scenario.
applyHint: Nothing in your data has changed. Press Run to compare; the change only runs inside a transaction and is rolled back.

warn.unknownTitle: Numbers that are not in the evidence
warn.unknownBody: These numbers in the answer are not in the evidence sent to the AI, so do not trust them before checking yourself: {numbers}.
warn.bannedTitle: A sentence implies the design is fine
warn.bannedBody: The system does not conclude that; it can only say whether the scenario that ran broke or did not break, and at which step. The sentence was:

err.auth: Sign in to ask the AI
err.network: The request could not be sent
err.stream: The AI reported an error while answering
